title: Creating a Mood with Lighting | Inside Pixar: Foundations | Pixar
speaker: Pixar
zh: 【Pixar】用燈光營造氣氛 |皮克斯內部：基本款 |皮克斯（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: WOMAN: In computer graphic scenes, we have to place lights so that you're not only able to see, but also to establish
cues.en: WOMAN: In computer graphic scenes, we have to place lights so that you're not only able to see, but also to establish
cues.zh: 女：在電腦圖形場景中，我們必須放置燈光，以便您不僅能夠看到，還能夠建立

cues.text: the time of day and define mood for the scene,
cues.en: the time of day and define mood for the scene,
cues.zh: 一天中的時間並定義場景的情緒，

cues.text: whether it's scary, or happy, or sad.
cues.en: whether it's scary, or happy, or sad.
cues.zh: 無論是害怕，還是快樂，還是悲傷。

cues.text: So you're saying that lighting makes a scene looks scary, or happy, or sad?
cues.en: So you're saying that lighting makes a scene looks scary, or happy, or sad?
cues.zh: 所以你是說燈光讓場景看起來可怕、快樂或悲傷？

cues.text: Why does this look so cold and ominous?
cues.en: Why does this look so cold and ominous?
cues.zh: 為什麼這看起來如此冰冷和不祥？

cues.text: Why does this feel like an interrogation?
cues.en: Why does this feel like an interrogation?
cues.zh: 為什麼這感覺像是在審問？

cues.text: NARRATOR: Hmm, I thought I was the one asking the questions here.
cues.en: NARRATOR: Hmm, I thought I was the one asking the questions here.
cues.zh: 旁白：嗯，我以為我是在這裡問問題的人。
